system.description:
You sway your chakra feathers back and forth. Up to two creatures you choose that can see you within range must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Targets that fail against this jutsu can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself on a success.

Critical Success: Affected creatures are able to resist the effects of this jutsu.

Success: Affected creatures gains 1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken until the beginning of your next turn.

Failure: Affected target gains 1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken, your choice.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they are also Dazed.

Irradiated: The dance entraps everyone and catches the eyes of everyone around. Its range becomes Self (30-Foot radius).

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 (or 2-star chakra) and the ranks of either Demoralized or Shaken (your choice), by +1.
